extension.description: Write AV signal flow diagrams (系統図) as text. Live preview, and the wiring that plugs in but carries nothing gets flagged as you type.
config.preview.theme: Preview theme. `auto` follows the editor's colour theme. A `diagram { theme: … }` in the source wins over both.
config.diagnostics.delay: How long to wait after typing stops before checking, in milliseconds.
config.preview.delay: How long to wait after typing stops before redrawing the preview, in milliseconds. Redrawing a whole diagram costs more than checking one line, so this is slower than the diagnostics delay.
